'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Shaun Janssen LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Shaun Janssen]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Last Place Deck LS
* '''Username:''' Jeretarius98
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
